court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Principal District Judge, Krishanagiri, A.S. No. 46 of 2016

parties.respondent_defendant: N. Saroja, The Assistant Engineer, Doordarshan T.V. Relay Centre, Krishnagiri, The Special District Revenue Officer, N.H.46, Jakkappan Nagar, Krishnagiri 635 001, The Special Thasildar, (Land Acquisition), Krishnagiri (Respondents)

facts_of_case: The Appellant is the first Defendant in O.S. No. 38 of 2004. The Respondent is the Plaintiff in the said suit. The case concerns a partition dispute.

legal_principles.principle: An illegitimate child is entitled to a share in the ancestral property, but only up to a certain percentage.
legal_principles.held: The Plaintiff is the illegitimate child of Narayanasamy and if at all she is entitled to any share, she is entitled only to 1/9th share in the suit properties.

legal_principles.principle: A joint family property can be treated as such even if it is sold and re-purchased.
legal_principles.held: The first Defendant’s father Narayanasamy sold some of the ancestral joint family properties and improved the house property and also purchased some suit properties from the purchase money of the ancestral property.

outcome.final_order: The Second Appeal filed by the Appellant was allowed.

use_for_drafting: appealing a judgment in a family court
filing a second appeal in a district court
